user.title: Set up Sensa Nomad
user.description: Enter your registration code (e.g. SENSA-A4B2-C7D9-E1F3), or leave it blank to start a 14-day trial. You'll need internet for this step only.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Sensa Nomad
reconfigure.description: Update your Sensa Nomad setup details and rescan devices.

discovery_settings.title: Network Scan
discovery_settings.description: Choose the subnet to scan for devices. Other devices (routers, gateways, etc.) are configured after setup.

confirm_devices.title: Discovered devices
confirm_devices.description: Select the devices that belong to your system.

register.title: Let's finish your setup

progress.scan_network: Scanning the network for devices. This may take a few seconds.
progress.creating_dashboards: Creating dashboards. Home Assistant will restart automatically once setup is complete.
progress.restarting: Setup complete. Home Assistant is restarting to apply dashboard changes. This page will reload automatically.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single Sensa Nomad instance is supported.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Sensa backend. Check that the add-on is running.
abort.dashboard_create_failed: Dashboard creation failed. Check the logs for details.
abort.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the logs for details.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Sensa backend.
error.invalid_subnet: Enter a valid subnet in CIDR format, for example 192.168.1.0/24.
error.licence_invalid: That registration code doesn't look right. Double-check and try again.
error.licence_slot_occupied: This licence is already activated on different hardware. Contact Sensa support to reset the binding.
error.licence_rebind_limit: This licence has been moved between devices too many times recently. Please contact Sensa support.
error.licence_unreachable: We couldn't reach the Sensa licensing service. You need internet to register — check your connection and try again.
error.licence_unavailable: Licence service returned an unexpected response — try again in a few moments.
error.trial_exhausted: This hardware has already used its free trial. Enter a purchased registration code to continue.
error.registration_required: Please enter your name and a valid email address.
